projects.summary: The furniture industry has been growing consistently since 2009 at a rate of 6-7% year-over-year (approximately double the US economic growth rate for the same period). Driving this growth is the buying power of Generation Y, which is expected to be a much easier demographic to convince to shop for home furnishings online. Specifically, Online Household Furniture sales is expected to be the fastest growing segment of the furniture market, faster than Furniture Stores, Furniture Wholesaling and Furniture Manufacturing (IBIS World, 2017). Life Cycle Stage – Growing Revenue Volatility – Medium Capital Intensity – Medium Industry Assistance – None Concentration Level - Medium Regulation Level – Light Technology Change – Medium Barriers to Entry – Medium Industry Globalization – Low Competition Level – High (IBIS World, 2017)

I’m a customer experience and customer success executive who has spent my career transforming how organizations serve, support, and build trust with the people who rely on them most. Whether it's patients depending on life‑changing medical devices, consumers navigating a complex healthcare system, or individuals making critical financial decisions, I’ve led teams and enterprises through the kind of change that elevates customer experience from a functional necessity to a competitive advantage.

Across Insulet, Drizly/Uber, Biogen, and Fidelity, I’ve built and scaled large, high‑performing organizations—often in highly regulated, mission‑critical environments—where quality, safety, and reliability are non‑negotiable. My leadership has consistently delivered measurable results: reduced churn, stronger loyalty, improved operational performance, more predictable outcomes, and better alignment between customer needs and business priorities.

What defines my approach is simple: I build organizations that customers trust and leaders are proud to run.

I specialize in:

Leading enterprise‑wide customer experience, support, and retention organizations
Driving digital and AI‑enabled transformation across contact centers and service models
Designing governance, insights, and operating rhythms that create clarity and accountability
Turning customer understanding into strategy, and strategy into measurable financial outcomes
Growing leaders, elevating cultures, and unifying cross‑functional teams around the customer

I’m at my best when an organization is scaling, evolving, or preparing for its next chapter of growth. I love strengthening the connective tissue between Product, Operations, Quality, Sales, and Data teams—ensuring the customer experience is intentional, predictable, and strategically grounded.
Above all, I believe exceptional customer experience is not just about delight. It’s about trust, consistency, and designing systems that work every time, especially when customers are counting on them the most.
